blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Tool-using language-model agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection because they must act on untrusted external content. Existing training-time defenses can reduce attack success rates, but often at the cost of general capabilities. We show that training-based defenses induce substantial drift in the model’s output distribution, altering its behavior even in benign settings and providing a potential mechanism for utility degradation. We further identify a failure mode of these defenses: On benign tool-use tasks, the model refrains from a step needed to finish an authorized task, particularly when that step is indicated by a tool output. To address these limitations, we introduce RAISED (Robust Attack Invariance through SElf-Distillation), a training framework that combines self-generation and self-distillation. The model first generates its own tool-use scenarios, with an emphasis on cases where task completion requires acting on legitimate guidance from tool outputs. Then, through self-distillation, the student is trained to match the teacher’s clean-context behavior on both clean and injected variants of the same trajectory. RAISED substantially reduces the attack success rate of prompt injections in tool responses while, unlike prior training-based defenses, preserving utility on both agentic and general-purpose benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 使用工具的语言模型剂容易被间接地即时注射,因为它们必须针对不信任的外部内容采取行动。 现有的训练时间防御能够降低攻击成功率,但往往以一般能力为代价. 我们显示,基于训练的防御手段会诱发模型输出分配的大幅波动,甚至在良性环境下也会改变其行为,并提供一个潜在的功能退化机制. 我们还发现了这些防御的失败模式: 在良性工具使用任务方面,该模型避免采取完成授权任务所需的步骤,特别是在工具输出表明该步骤时。 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了RAISED(通过Self-Distillation进行Robust attack Invarance),这是一个将自我生成和自我分化相结合的培训框架. 该模型首先产生其自身的工具使用设想,重点是任务完成需要根据工具产出的合理指导采取行动的情况。 然后,通过自我消化,对学生进行培训,使其与老师在同样轨迹的清洁和注入变体上的清洁文字行为相匹配。 RAISED大大降低了工具响应中迅速注射的攻击成功率,而与以往基于训练的防御不同,它保持了在代理和通用基准上的效用。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Tool-using LLM agents are deployed as browsing assistants, coding assistants, and enterprise copilots, connected to emails, documents, CRM systems, and other services through APIs or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Yao et al. (2023) ; Schick et al. (2023) ; Qin et al. (2023) ; Zhou et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024a) ; Jimenez et al. (2024) .
Through these tools, agents process untrusted content from webpages, emails, documents and tool outputs. This exposes them to indirect prompt injection, where instructions hidden in that content hijack the agent away from its assigned task Greshake et al. (2023) .
Real-world attacks have already demonstrated this risk, including attacks that secretly extracted data from productivity tools Reddy and Gujral (2025) and manipulated MCP-based agents Beurer-Kellner and Fischer (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025) .
This growing threat has motivated a range of defenses, including prompting, filtering, and training-time alignment methods, all of which face a trade-off between robustness and utility Liu et al. (2024a) : the model must resist adversarial instructions in untrusted tool outputs while still acting on the task-relevant guidance they may contain.

blocks.en: Training-based defenses aim to improve robustness while preserving benign behavior Chen et al. (2024) ; Chen et al. (2025) . However, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on targets drawn from an external source rather than the base model’s own output distribution can shift the model away from its original behavior Yang et al. (2024) . Preference-based defenses instead use direct preference optimization (DPO) to favor legitimate-task responses over responses to injected instructions Rafailov et al. (2024) . Even when the preferred responses come from the original model, as in SecAlign++ ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , DPO optimizes them relative to rejected responses on contexts containing injections without directly matching the model’s predictive distribution on clean contexts.

blocks.en:
Beyond general output-distribution drift, we identify a failure mode in training-based defenses: models execute benign tool-use tasks up to a point, then refrain from an authorized step that depends on guidance from a tool output. This leaves the task unfinished, even when the model is explicitly instructed to complete it end to end without further user involvement. The training objective creates an asymmetry: it consistently pushes the model away from responses that follow injected directions in tool outputs, while providing much less signal to
follow legitimate actionable information from the same channel. The observed failures match a natural shortcut under this asymmetry: the model uses tool outputs as information but avoids acting on their guidance, even when doing so is necessary to complete the authorized task.
blocks.zh:
除了一般的输出-分配漂移,我们确定基于训练的防御的失败模式:模型执行良性的工具-使用任务直到某个点,然后避免一个依赖于工具输出的指向的授权步骤. 这使得任务没有完成,即使模式被明确指示完成,在没有用户进一步参与的情况下结束. 培训目标造成不对称:它始终将模型推开,使其远离在工具产出中注入方向的响应,同时向
跟踪同一频道的合法可操作信息。 观测到的故障与这种不对称下的自然捷径相匹配:该模型使用工具输出作为信息,但避免按照它们的指导行事,即使这样做对于完成授权的任务是必要的.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce RAISED , a framework combining self-generation and self-distillation. A frozen copy of the model being defended serves as both the data generator and the teacher, while a trainable copy serves as the student.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们引入了RAISED,一个结合自我生成和自我消化的框架。 被保护的模型的被冻结副本既是数据生成者,也是教师,而可训练副本则是学生。

blocks.en: In the self-generation stage, the frozen model creates tool-use scenarios emphasizing cases where task completion requires acting on legitimate guidance from tool outputs. The same model generates both the clean task-solving trajectories and the injections for their tool outputs.
blocks.zh: 在自我生成阶段,被冻结的模型创造了工具使用情景,强调任务完成需要根据工具产出的合理指导采取行动的情况。 同样的模型既生成干净的任务解析轨迹,又为其工具输出注入.

blocks.en: In the self-distillation stage, the student is trained on clean and injected contexts to match the teacher’s next-token distribution on the corresponding clean context via KL divergence. On clean contexts, this limits output-distribution drift; on injected contexts, it trains the student to be insensitive to the injection while preserving legitimate tool-output guidance. Together, these target a model-relative robustness ideal: preserving the base model’s behavior on clean contexts while recovering that behavior on their injected counterparts.
blocks.zh: 在自我消化阶段,学生接受清洁和注入语境的培训,以通过KL差异来匹配教师在相应的清洁语境上的相邻分布. 在清洁上下文中,这限制了输出-分配漂移;在注入上下文中,它训练学生对注入不敏感,同时保留合法的工具输出指导. 这些共同的目标是一种模型相对的强健性理想:在清洁环境上保持基本模型的行为,同时在注入的对应物上恢复该行为。

blocks.en: We evaluate RAISED on general-knowledge, agentic-capability, and prompt-injection benchmarks across different models and compare against undefended agents, prompting, filtering, and alignment-based defenses, measuring benign utility, utility under attack, and attack success rate (ASR). On AgentDojo with Gemma, RAISED reduces ASR from 39.5% to 1.0% and increases utility under attack from 64.0% to 80.5%, while losing only 1 point of benign utility. This matches the robustness of SecAlign++ without its 7-point drop.
blocks.zh: 我们通过各种模式,并对照无防御剂、诱导、过滤和基于对齐的防御、测量良性效用、被攻击的效用和攻击成功率,对RAISED进行评估。 在与Gemma的Agent Dojo上,RAISED将ASR从39.5%降低到1.0%,并将攻击下的功用从64.0%提升到80.5%,同时只损失了1分良性功用. 这与SecAlign++的稳健性不相上下7分相匹配.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We show that existing training-based defenses can induce output-distribution drift on benign settings and identify a behavioral failure mode in which defended models leave authorized tasks unfinished. • We introduce RAISED, a framework that combines self-generation and self-distillation to train models to resist prompt injections while preserving their behavior on benign tasks. • We show across three open-weight models and multiple general-knowledge, agentic-capability, and prompt-injection benchmarks that RAISED reduces attack success rates and improves utility under attack while preserving benign utility.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Instructions injected in content retrieved by an agent can be mistaken for legitimate user instructions ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) . This threat extends direct prompt injection ( Perez and Ribeiro, 2022 ; Branch et al., 2022 ) to agents that retrieve untrusted content, including tool responses. Later work mapped this attack surface ( Lee and Tiwari, 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ) and developed benchmarks that plant injections in the tool outputs of interactive environments ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 在代理检索的内容中注入的说明可能被误认为合法的用户指示(Greshake等,2023.). 这种威胁将直接的即时注射(Perez和Ribeiro, 2022;Branch等人, 2022)扩大到回收不可信内容的毒剂,包括工具反应。 后来的工作绘制了攻击表面(Lee and Tiwari, 2024;Yu等人, 2024;Liu等人, 2025b;Wang等人, 2026),并制定了在交互环境的工具输出中植入注射的基准(Zhan等人, 2024;Debenderetti等人, 2024;Li等人, 2026)。

blocks.en:
Liu et al. (2024a) organize defenses into two strategies, preventing injections from taking effect and detecting them at inference time, and suggest training the model itself to resist them as a direction for future work. Prevention defenses modify the agent’s context so that injected text loses its effect, for instance by marking untrusted content through spotlighting ( Hines et al., 2024 ) or repeating the user task after the untrusted content through prompt sandwiching ( Learn Prompting, 2024 ) . Prevention can also be enforced at the system level: CaMeL ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ) fixes the control flow from the trusted user query and enforces capability-based policies outside the model. Detection defenses run a classifier on untrusted inputs, such as PromptGuard ( Wan et al., 2024 ; Chennabasappa et al., 2025 ) , whose robustness has itself been benchmarked ( Zizzo et al., 2025 ) and evaded ( Hackett et al., 2025 ) . Model-level defenses train the model to resist injected instructions, through instruction hierarchies ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , instruction-priority embeddings ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , task-specific models never trained to follow instructions ( Piet et al., 2024 ) , structured queries with fine-tuning ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , or preference optimization ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . RAISED instead uses the model’s clean-context predictive distribution as a direct training target.
SecAlign++ ( Chen et al., 2026 ) also derives preferred responses from the base model, but uses
them as sequence-level preference targets rather than matching the predictive distribution itself.

blocks.en:
Consistency training augments a prompt with irrelevant cues and trains the model to preserve its clean-prompt behavior; Chua et al. (2025) use it against biased chain-of-thought and Irpan et al. (2025) against sycophancy and jailbreaks, both on single-turn prompts. On-policy distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) provides dense per-token supervision along the student’s own rollouts. Self-distillation uses a copy of the student as teacher, conditioned on privileged context: a document ( Kujanpää et al., 2025 ) , a verified reasoning trace ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , a safety context ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , or a user’s follow-up ( Buening et al., 2026 ) . Self-generated targets also limit fine-tuning forgetting ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . RAISED applies consistency training to multi-turn tool-use trajectories, where the injection sits inside
a tool observation and legitimate guidance may share that channel. It distils off-policy from stored
top- K K teacher distributions along the clean continuation, and generates both its training scenarios
and its attacks with the model being defended, including scenarios where completing the task requires
acting on legitimate guidance returned through a tool.

blocks.en: Prior work has used language models to synthesize instruction data ( Wang et al., 2023 ) and tool-use or function-calling data, including Toolformer ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , ToolAlpaca ( Tang et al., 2023 ) , ToolLLM ( Qin et al., 2023 ) , APIGen ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and ToolACE ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . APIGen and ToolACE additionally use execution-based checks to filter generated examples. RAISED applies model-based generation and execution-based validation to agent trajectories. Whereas prior injection-training pipelines rely on templated attacks ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , RAISED has the defended model write its own injections, in an attacker role, after solving each scenario.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作曾使用语言模型来合成指导数据(Wang等,2023年)和工具使用或函数调用数据,包括Tolformer(Schick等,2023年),Tollearpaca(Tang等,2023年),TolleLLM. (秦等,2023年),APIGen (刘等,2024b),和TolleACE (刘等,2025a.). APIGen和TolleACE额外使用基于执行的检查来过滤生成的例子. RAISED将基于模型的生成和执行的验证应用于代理轨迹. 先前的注射训练管道依靠模板攻击(Chen等,2024;Chen等,2025),而RAISED则在解决了每一种情况后,以攻击者的角色,用被保护的模型写出自己的注射.

blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation and Threat Model
blocks.zh: 3 问题拟订和威胁模式

blocks.en: 3.1 Agent Setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 代理设置

blocks.en: A tool-using agent receives a system prompt, a user request u u , and a menu of tools 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . It acts in turns: at each turn it either calls a tool, which changes the environment state and returns an observation o j o_{j} (a search result, an e-mail, an API response), or writes a final answer. The context c j c_{j} seen by the model before turn j j is the rendering of everything so far: system prompt, tool menu, user request, and the alternating actions and observations. The episode starts from an environment state s 0 s_{0} , ends in a state s J s_{J} , and succeeds if a success check G u ​ ( s J ) G_{u}(s_{J}) holds, i.e. if the request was actually fulfilled. Observations are the only part of the context that comes from outside the agent’s trust boundary. They may legitimately contain instructions (“to confirm, enter the code sent to your inbox”), so ignoring all instructions in tool outputs would amount to the tool-output distrust as a source of guidance failure mode described in Section 1 . The formal definitions are given in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.2 Threat Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 威胁模式

blocks.en:
The adversary controls the output of one or more tools and inserts an adversarial string adv \mathrm{adv} at a chosen position inside an observation; we write c ~ \tilde{c} for the resulting injected context, which differs from the clean context c c only inside tool observations. The adversary does not control the system prompt, the user request, the model parameters or the decoding procedure, and cannot access gradients or logits. Its goal is a check G adv ​ ( s J ) G_{\mathrm{adv}}(s_{J}) on the final state: an unintended tool call, a disclosure, or a harmful action.
When the goal is a tool call, we assume the targeted tool is in 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , so that no attack fails merely because the requested action cannot be executed. We consider static attacks, where adv \mathrm{adv} is chosen independently of the defended model, as in InjecAgent, AgentDojo, and AgentDyn.

blocks.en: 4 The Utility Cost of Training-Based Defenses
blocks.zh: 4 以训练为基础的防卫的效用成本

blocks.en: As discussed earlier, training-based prompt-injection defenses can alter benign behavior in two ways: by shifting the model’s output distribution and by leaving tool-use tasks unfinished when completion depends on guidance from a tool output. We analyze these effects below.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,基于训练的即时注射防御可以以两种方式改变良性行为:改变模型的输出分布,在完成取决于工具输出的指导时将工具使用任务留作未完成. 下面我们分析这些影响。

blocks.en: 4.1 Cost 1: Output-Distribution Drift in Benign Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 费用1:在Benign设置中分配产出

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of the objective from that of the data, we evaluate SFT, DPO, and the self-distillation objective used by RAISED under the same data and training setup, varying only the objective and its targets. All methods use 5K injection-augmented trajectories, rank-16 LoRA, and 313 training steps. Under this short, parameter-efficient training regime, SFT and DPO induce measurable output-distribution drift on the held-out benign set. As shown in Fig. 2 , self-distillation yields forward and reverse KL of only 0.0010 0.0010 , respectively 44 × 44\times and 55 × 55\times lower than SFT and 29 × 29\times and 30 × 30\times lower than DPO, while reaching 0.993 0.993 top-1 agreement with the base model. Section B.1 provides the full controlled setup and shows that the drift increases with additional SFT and DPO training, while self-distillation remains close to the base distribution. While this analysis does not establish that output-distribution drift directly causes downstream utility loss, it shows that standard defensive training can substantially alter the model’s behavior on benign inputs, identifying a potential contributor to utility degradation that self-distillation largely avoids.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cost 2: Behavioral Drift in Benign Tool Use
blocks.zh: 4.2 成本2: Benign工具使用中的行为漂移

blocks.en: Beyond output-distribution drift, defensive training can also change how the model acts on benign tool outputs. Figure 3 shows a representative example: the base model retrieves a verification code returned through the available tools and completes the authorized password change, whereas the defended model stops at that step and asks the user for the code despite being instructed to complete the task end to end. This behavior exposes a shortcut in defensive training: the optimization signal consistently pushes the model away from responses that follow injected directions in tool outputs, while providing much less signal for acting on legitimate guidance from the same channel. The observed failures follow this pattern: the model uses tool outputs as information while becoming reluctant to act on their guidance, leaving otherwise solvable tasks unfinished. Section B.2 provides additional examples across Gemma and Nemotron, including separate failures for SFT and SecAlign++, and shows that RAISED completes the corresponding tasks on which these defenses fail.
blocks.zh: 除了输出-分配漂移外,防御性训练还可以改变模型如何对良性工具输出起作用。 图3显示了一个具有代表性的例子:基础模型通过可用工具检索返回的验证码并完成授权的密码更改,而被保护的模型则止于该步骤并询问用户,尽管被指示完成任务结束. 这种行为暴露了防守训练中的捷径:优化信号始终将模型从工具输出中遵循注入方向的响应推开,同时为在同一通道的合法引导下行动提供的信号要少得多. 观察到的失败遵循了这种模式:该模型使用工具输出作为信息,同时不愿按照它们的指导采取行动,使否则可以完成的任务未完成。 B.2节提供了跨Gemma和Nemotron的额外例子,包括SFT和SecAlign++的单独故障,并显示RAISED完成了这些防御失败的相应任务.

blocks.en: 5.1 Stage 1: Self-Generation
blocks.zh: 5.1 第1阶段:自我成长

blocks.en: Stage 1 uses the frozen model p θ 0 p_{\theta_{0}} in three roles: generating a scenario, solving and verifying it, and generating an attack. These roles are executed as independent model calls, with no model state carried between them.
blocks.zh: 第1阶段使用被冻结的型号p 0 p_{\tethata_{0}} 在三个角色中:生成情景,解析并验证,并生成攻击. 这些角色作为独立的模型调用执行,它们之间没有带模型状态.

blocks.en: Scenario generation. The base model generates a small executable tool-use environment: a world state as a JSON object, tools implemented as Python functions that read and update it, a user request, and a Python success check. Each request is designed to require a chain of dependent tool calls, in which later steps rely on earlier outputs. To target the failure mode of Section 4.2 , we steer generation toward scenarios where completing the request requires acting on legitimate guidance surfaced through a tool output. For example, the output may reveal a required next step, offer a recovery path after an unsuccessful action, or indicate that a seemingly completed step needs follow-up. The trained model must therefore distinguish such task-relevant guidance from injected instructions. We create these cases by prompting the model with high-level patterns, which it may freely instantiate, combine, or extend.
blocks.zh: 情景生成. 基础模型生成一个小可执行的工具使用环境:作为JSON对象的世界状态,作为读取和更新它的Python函数执行的工具,用户请求,以及Python成功检查. 每个请求都是为了需要一系列依赖性的工具呼叫,其中后期的步骤依赖于更早的产出. 为了针对第4.2节的失败模式,我们引导一代人走向需要通过工具输出在合法指导下采取行动才能完成请求的情景。 例如,产出可能显示下一步需要,在未成功的行动后提供恢复路径,或表明似乎已经完成的步骤需要后续。 因此,经过培训的模式必须区分这种与任务有关的指导与注入的指示。 我们通过高层次模式来创造这些案例,它可以自由即兴、结合或扩展。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Behavioral drift on a benign tool-use task. The base model completes the task, while the defended model stops at the tool-guided step and defers it to the user. This failure pattern occurs in both prior training-based defenses we study. Additional examples are in Section B.2 .

blocks.en: Solve and verify. The same frozen model then attempts to complete the user request by interacting with the generated tools. The rollout uses the model’s standard tool-use interface, without modifying its normal inference procedure: tool calls are executed against the shared world state and their actual outputs are returned to the model.
blocks.zh: 解决和核实。 同一被冻结的模型然后试图通过与生成的工具互动来完成用户请求. 推出使用模型的标准工具-使用界面,而不修改其正常的推论程序: 工具调用会针对共享的世界状态执行,其实际输出会还给模型.

blocks.en: Attack generation. For each retained trajectory, we sample eligible tool outputs to carry generated injections. For each sampled output, the frozen model generates the adversarial content and chooses where within the output to insert it. The attacker is deliberately restricted to the untrusted channel: it does not observe the user request or the full task-solving trajectory.
blocks.zh: 出击 对每个保留轨迹,我们抽取合格的工具输出,以进行产生的注射。 对于每个被抽取的输出,被冷冻的模型会产生对抗性内容,并选择在输出内的位置来插入. 攻击者被故意限制在无信任的通道上:它不观察用户请求或全部任务解析轨迹.

blocks.en: Training data. The retained trajectories, their stored injections, and the frozen model’s next-token distributions along the model responses form the training data used in Stage 2.

blocks.en: 6.1 Models and Evaluated Defenses
blocks.zh: 6.1 模型和评估辩护

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation considers two instruction-tuned, tool-capable language models from different families: Gemma-4-12B-it and Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Both support structured function calling and exhibit substantially different baseline susceptibility to indirect prompt injection. We additionally evaluate RAISED on Qwen3.8-27B in Appendix D.6 to test the method in a substantially stronger baseline robustness regime, where the undefended model already achieves low prompt-injection attack success rates on AgentDojo and AgentDyn.
blocks.zh: 我们的初级评价考虑了来自不同家庭的两种经过指导调整、具有工具能力的语言模型:Gemma-4-12B-it和Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B。 这两种支持结构化功能调用并显示出对间接即时注射有很大不同的基线易感性。 我们还在附录D.6中的Qwen3.8-27B上对RAISED进行了评估,以在大大加强的基准稳健性制度下测试该方法,在该制度中,未防御模型已经实现了低速注射,攻击了Agent Dojo和AgentDyn的成功率。

blocks.en:
We compare against representative defenses spanning four families. Vanilla denotes the undefended instruction-tuned model. As prompting-based defenses, we evaluate Prompt Sandwiching Learn Prompting (2024) and Spotlighting Hines et al. (2024) . As a filtering defense, we use PromptGuard 2 Chennabasappa et al. (2025) . Finally, among alignment-based defenses, we evaluate SecAlign++ Chen et al. (2026) and RAISED (ours).
Trained defenses are run over three seeds (mean ± std), details are in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 7.2 RAISED preserves benign agentic capabilities

blocks.en: Table 2 reports performance on five benign tool-use benchmarks.

blocks.en: On Gemma, RAISED preserves benign tool-use performance across all five benchmarks. The largest change is on WorkBench, where performance increases from 55.9 to 61.5 ± 0.7 61.5\pm 0.7 , while BFCL and MMT-Bench remain essentially unchanged. A plausible explanation is that RAISED repeatedly trains on verified multi-step trajectories that require maintaining state and completing sequences of interdependent actions, which closely matches the type of task evaluated by WorkBench. Although we do not isolate this effect causally, the result suggests that robustness training can reinforce some forms of multi-step tool use rather than merely preserve them.

blocks.zh: 7.3 一般能力仍接近基准模式

blocks.en: RAISED preserves general capabilities across all ten benchmarks for Gemma and Nemotron (Table 3 ), with scores close to the Vanilla checkpoints and no systematic degradation. Variations are small and mixed in sign, indicating that the gains in prompt-injection robustness do not come at the cost of general or benign agentic capabilities. This consistency across two model families supports the objective of clean-context self-distillation, which constrains defensive training toward behavior already exhibited by the base model rather than an externally defined target.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced RAISED, a self-distillation defense that trains the model to be invariant to prompt injection. The model generates its own tool-use scenarios and injections, including cases where completing the task requires acting on legitimate guidance from a tool output, and learns to match its clean-context next-token distributions on injected contexts. RAISED matches or exceeds the robustness of SecAlign++ while better preserving benign utility, and induces far less distribution drift than SFT or DPO. More broadly, when the desired behavior already exists in the clean model, defensive training should preserve it under attack rather than learn a new defensive policy. Since RAISED preserves the base model’s behavior rather than improving it, it also inherits its errors; we discuss this and other limitations in Appendix G , and broader impact in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 我们引入了RAISED,一种自我消化防御,它训练模型不易变异以迅速注射. 该模型产生自己的工具使用情景和注入,包括需要根据工具输出的合理指导来完成该任务的情况,并学习在被注入的上下文上匹配其干净的下接式分布. RAISED匹配或超过SecAlign++的坚固性,同时更好地维护良性效用,并诱发比SFT或DPO更小的分布漂移. 更广义地说,当所期望的行为已经存在于清洁模型中时,防御训练应该保护它受到攻击,而不是学习新的防御政策. 由于RAISED保留了基础模型的行为,而不是改进它,它也继承了它的错误;我们在附录G中讨论了这个和其他限制,在附录H中讨论了更广泛的影响。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies defenses against indirect prompt injection in tool-using language-model agents. Because the evaluation and training procedures include the generation and execution of adversarial prompt injections, the techniques described in this paper have potential dual-use implications. Our intent is to improve the robustness and reliability of language-model agents operating over untrusted external content. The attacks considered in this work are evaluated in controlled benchmark environments and are used to measure and strengthen defensive behavior. RAISED should be viewed as a defense-in-depth mechanism and not as a substitute for established safeguards such as access control, sandboxing, capability restriction, and least-privilege tool design.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了防止在使用语言模型的工具剂中间接地即时注射的防御. 由于评估和培训程序包括生成和执行对抗性即时注射,本文件所述技术具有潜在的双重用途影响。 我们的用意是提高语言模型代理商在不受信任的外部内容上的稳健性和可靠性. 本作中考虑的攻击在被控制的基准环境中得到评价,并被用来衡量和加强防御行为. 应将RAISED视为一个深入防御的机制,而不是替代既定的保障措施,如出入控制、沙箱、能力限制和最不优惠的工具设计等。

blocks.en: B.1 Controlled Output-Distribution Drift Analysis

blocks.en: We compare SFT, DPO, and self-distillation while holding the training data and parameter-efficient fine-tuning setup fixed. All three objectives use the same 5K injection-augmented tool-use trajectories, with identical trajectory contexts, injection placements, and supervised model-generated positions, and are trained with rank-16 LoRA for 313 steps. They differ only in their supervision: SFT uses fixed response targets, DPO contrasts preferred and rejected responses generated from the frozen base model, and self-distillation uses the frozen base model’s next-token distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了SFT、DPO和自我分解,同时将培训数据和参数效率微调设置固定下来。 所有三个目标都使用相同的5K注射增强工具使用轨迹,具有相同的轨迹上下文,注射投放,以及被监督的模型生成位置,并接受分级为16LORA的313步训练. 它们只在监督方面有所不同: SFT使用固定的响应目标,DPO比较偏好并拒绝由被冷冻的基态模型生成的响应,自沉还原则使用被冷冻的基态模型的相邻相接分布.

blocks.en: We construct a held-out set of 500 standalone questions, with 125 examples from each of four public benchmark sources: ARC-Easy, TriviaQA, GSM8K, and SciQ. These questions contain neither tool use nor prompt injections and are used only for this analysis. We retain questions that the base model answers correctly, so the comparison focuses on behavior already exhibited by the original checkpoint. We also remove any question liable to provoke a refusal or guarded reply.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一套500个独立问题,其中125个实例来自四个公共基准来源:ARC-Easy、TriviaQA、GSM8K和SciQ。 这些问题既不包含工具使用,也不包含即时注射,仅用于这一分析. 我们保留了基本模型正确回答的问题,因此比较的重点是原始检查点已经显示的行为. 我们还删除任何可能引起拒绝或谨慎答复的问题。

blocks.en: For each question, we first generate the base model’s greedy answer y 1 : T y_{1:T} . We then teacher-force that same answer through the base model and every trained checkpoint and record the next-token distribution p θ ( ⋅ ∣ x , y < t ) p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x,y_{<t}) at each answer position t t . Forward and reverse KL divergence are averaged over all evaluated positions and questions, as defined in Eq. 2 . We also report top-1 agreement, the fraction of positions at which the trained checkpoint and base model assign highest probability to the same next token. Using the same answer prefixes for every checkpoint isolates changes in the predictive distributions from differences caused by generating different answers.
blocks.zh: 对于每个问题,我们首先生成基础模型的贪婪答案 y 1 : T y_{1:T}. 然后,我们通过基准模型和每个经过训练的检查站提供同样的答案,并记录每个答题位置的下接点分发情况。 如Eq. 2所定义,在所有评价的职位和问题中,前向和后向KL的相差均值。 我们还报告最高一级协议,即训练有素的检查站和基地模式给同一下个标志分配最大概率的职位的一小部分。 每个检查点使用相同的答案前缀,将预测分布的变化从生成不同答案引起的差异中隔离出.

blocks.en: The three objectives differ in how they constrain the trained model relative to the base model. SFT maximizes the likelihood of a fixed target sequence. At each supervised position, this pushes probability toward the target token but does not preserve the base model’s probabilities over alternative tokens; when the targets come from another source, the resulting distribution can therefore move away from the base model.
blocks.zh: 这三个目标在如何限制训练有素的模型与基准模型之间有所不同。 SFT使固定目标序列的可能性最大化. 在每一个受监督的位置,这都会把概率推向目标指使,但并不能保持基准模型相对于替代指使的概率;当目标来自另一个来源时,由此产生的分布因此可以脱离基准模型.

blocks.en: DPO is also not a direct distribution-matching objective. For a preference example ( x , y w , y l ) (x,y_{w},y_{l}) , its loss can be written as ℒ DPO = − log ⁡ σ ⁡ ( β ⁡ [ log ⁡ π θ ​ ( y w ∣ x ) π 0 ​ ( y w ∣ x ) − log ⁡ π θ ​ ( y l ∣ x ) π 0 ​ ( y l ∣ x ) ] ) , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{DPO}}=-\log\sigma\!\left(\beta\left[\log\frac{\pi_{\theta}(y_{w}\mid x)}{\pi_{0}(y_{w}\mid x)}-\log\frac{\pi_{\theta}(y_{l}\mid x)}{\pi_{0}(y_{l}\mid x)}\right]\right), (5) where π 0 \pi_{0} is the frozen reference model. Although DPO is derived from a KL-regularized preference-learning objective Rafailov et al. (2024) , the training loss above constrains the relative preference between two sequences rather than directly matching the model’s next-token distribution to that of the reference model.

This distinction is particularly relevant for SecAlign-style prompt-injection training. In SecAlign, both responses are optimized under a context containing an injection. SecAlign++ improves target construction by generating the preferred response from the base model on the corresponding clean input, but DPO still evaluates the preferred and rejected responses under the injected training context Chen et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) . Thus, the base model’s predictive distribution on the clean context is not directly used as a training constraint.

blocks.en: C.1 Prompt Sandwiching
blocks.zh: C.1 迅速三明治

blocks.en: Prompt sandwiching, also called the repeat-user-prompt defense, is a training-free defense that restates the user’s task after untrusted content Learn Prompting (2024) . Following the implementation from SecAlign++ Chen et al. (2026) , we append the reminder “Please always remember that your task is: <task> ” after every new tool response and assign it the user role. For multi-turn interactions, the same original task is repeated after each successive tool response. As illustrated in Figure 4 , this places the trusted task immediately before the model’s next generation. Prompt sandwiching requires no fine-tuning or auxiliary model, but increases the context length by repeating the task after every tool response.

blocks.en: Spotlighting is a family of prompt-engineering defenses that transforms untrusted text to help the model distinguish it from trusted instructions Hines et al. (2024) . We use its delimiting variant, following the spotlighting_with_delimiting implementation evaluated in AgentDojo Debenedetti et al. (2024) . We append an instruction to the system prompt explaining that tool outputs will appear between << and >> and that instructions within these delimiters must not be followed. Every tool response is then wrapped with these markers, as illustrated in Figure 5 . The transformation is applied independently to each new tool response and requires no fine-tuning or auxiliary model.
blocks.zh: 焦点(Spotlighting)是一个由即时工程防御而成的家族,可转换出不可信文本来帮助模型将其与可信赖的指示Hines等(2024)相区别. 在Dojo Debenedetti 等人(2024年)中,我们使用它的分界线变体。 我们在系统上附加一个提示,解释工具输出将在QQ和QQ之间出现,这些分隔符内的指示不得被遵循. 如图5所示,每个工具响应都会被这些标记所包裹。 转换被独立应用于每个新工具响应,不需要微调或辅助模型.

blocks.zh: 图5:在聚光灯前和聚光灯后以划界方式提供消息。

blocks.en: C.3 PromptGuard2
blocks.zh: C.3 快速护卫2

blocks.en: Prompt Guard 2 is an 86M-parameter classifier developed by Meta to detect prompt injections and jailbreaks Chennabasappa et al. (2025) . Following the implementation from AgentDyn Li et al. (2026) , we apply the classifier independently to every new tool response and classify it as an injection when its safety score is below 0.5 0.5 . Responses classified as safe are left unchanged, while flagged responses are replaced in full by “ <Data omitted because a prompt injection was detected> ” before being passed to the agent, as illustrated in Figure 6 . Unlike the previous prompting defenses, this method removes suspicious content from the model’s context but requires running an auxiliary classifier after each tool call.
blocks.zh: Meta开发的86M参数分类器, 在AgentDyn Li等人(2026年)实施后,我们将分类器独立应用于每一个新工具响应,并在安全分数低于0.5分时将其分类为注射. 如图6所示,分类为安全的答复保持不变,而标出的答复则被全部替换为“`数据省略 ' ,因为发现迅速注射 " 。 与之前的提示性防御不同,这种方法从模型上下文中删除了可疑内容,但需要在每个工具调用后运行一个辅助分级器.

blocks.zh: 图6:在过滤工具响应之前和之后,用"快速守护2"进行消息反馈.

blocks.en: C.4 SecAlign++
blocks.zh: C.4 密钥++

blocks.en: SecAlign++ ( Chen et al., 2026 ) is the closest training-based baseline to RAISED. It refines SecAlign ( Chen et al., 2025 ) with three changes. First, the chat template gains a dedicated role for untrusted content, so that the model can learn to follow instructions from the system and user roles while treating text in that role as data. Second, training-time injections are placed before or after the clean input at random, rather than always appended to it, which prevents the model from learning a positional shortcut. Third, the preferred response in each preference pair is the undefended model’s own response to the clean instruction alone, so that the target is in-distribution for the model being trained, whereas the rejected response is the undefended model’s own response to the injected instruction alone, both sampled independently rather than produced within a single shared context. The model is then trained with DPO on these pairs, using LoRA.
blocks.zh: SecAlign++(Chen等,2026年)是离RAISED最近的基于训练的基准. 它精炼了SecAlign(Chen等,2025年),有3个修改. 首先,聊天模板为不可信内容获得一个专用角色,这样模型就可以学习遵循系统的指示和用户角色,同时将该角色中的文本作为数据处理. 第二,训练时间注射是随机放置在清洁输入之前或之后,而不是总是附加在后面,这阻碍了模型学习一个位置快捷键. 第三,每一首选组合中首选的反应是未设防的模型自己单独对干净的指令的反应,这样目标就可以被分配给正在训练的模型,而被拒绝的反应则是未设防的模型自己对被注入指令的反应,两者都是独立抽样的,而不是在一个共同的上下文中产生的. 随后该型号与DPO一起对这些对子进行训练,使用LORA.

blocks.en: The original recipe targets single-turn instruction following, with the untrusted content held in a single input message. We adapt it to the agentic setting at inference time by rendering tool-response messages with the input role of the SecAlign template, so that the model applies the learned trust boundary to real tool output.
blocks.zh: 最初的食谱以单回合指示为目标,不可信内容被单个输入信息所持有. 我们在推断时通过提供具有SecAlign模板输入作用的工具-响应消息来适应代理设置,这样模型就可以将学到的信任边界应用到真正的工具输出上.

blocks.en: The preference data follow the original SecAlign++ recipe: pairs are constructed from the Cleaned-Alpaca instruction set ( Ruebsamen, 2023 ) , and therefore contain no tool calls or tool responses. SecAlign++ is nevertheless evaluated by its authors on AgentDojo and other agentic benchmarks, relying on the learned trust boundary to transfer from single-turn untrusted inputs to tool outputs. We preserve this training setup for the method-level comparison. Our ablation in Appendix E separately evaluates the SecAlign++ DPO objective on agentic trajectories while controlling the training data and input representation.
blocks.zh: 首选数据遵循了最初的SecAlign++配方:对对由Cleaned-Alpaca指令集(Ruebsamen, 2023)构建而来,因此没有工具调用或工具响应. 尽管如此,SecAlign++还是由它的作者根据Agent Dojo和其他代理基准来评价,依靠已学到的信任边界,从一转不可信输入转移到工具输出. 我们保留这种培训设置,用于方法层面的比较。 我们在附录E中单独评价了SecAlign++ DPO关于代理轨迹的目标,同时控制了培训数据和输入表示.

blocks.en: We fine-tune with DPO ( β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 ) and LoRA (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 , applied to the query, key, value and output projections) for one epoch over 5,008 examples subsampled from Cleaned-Alpaca (313 steps at batch size 16), with a constant learning rate of 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} and no warm-up, in bfloat16 on one GB200 GPU per run; training is repeated over three seeds. This is a considerably smaller budget than the original recipe, which trains for several epochs over the full 51K-example set, and matches the budget of the controlled comparison in Section 4.1 ; the 625-step checkpoint of Section D.8 uses the same 10K-example training budget as RAISED. We use the 313-step checkpoint in the main comparison as a common operating point on the robustness–utility trade-off. On Gemma, SecAlign++ already reaches near-zero ASR on InjecAgent and AgentDojo at this budget and further training primarily reduces utility without materially improving robustness. On Nemotron, extending training to 625 steps further reduces ASR on AgentDojo and AgentDyn, but also increases degradation on several general and agentic capability benchmarks; the same qualitative trade-off is observed for Gemma and Qwen ( Section D.8 ). We therefore report the longer-training results separately.
blocks.zh: 我们与DPO(β=0.1\β=0.1)和LORA(排名16,α=32\α=32,适用于查询、关键、价值和产出预测)微调,从Cleaned-Alpaca(分批16分313个步骤)抽取5 008个实例,持续学习率为2×10−5 2.\Times 10×5),没有取暖,每跑1个GB200 GPU的bfloat16;通过3个种子重复培训。 这笔预算比最初的食谱要小得多,该食谱为整个51K-实例集的几个时代提供培训,并与第4.1节的控制比较预算相匹配;D.8节的625步检查站使用与RAISED相同的10K-实例培训预算。 我们使用313步的检查站进行主要比较,作为稳健性-实用性取舍的共同操作点。 在Gemma上,SecAlign++在本预算中已经达到InjecAgent和Agent Dojo的近零ASR,进一步培训主要会降低效用,而不会在实质上提高稳健性. 在尼莫特龙,将培训扩大到625个步骤进一步减少了对Agent Dojo和AgentDyn的ASR,但也增加了一些一般和代理能力基准的降解;对Gemma和Quen也观察到同样的质取舍(D.8节)。 因此,我们分别报告较长期培训的结果。

blocks.zh: C.5 RAISED - 通过Self-Distillation进行强力攻击

blocks.en: C.5.1 Self-Generation Details
blocks.zh: C.5.1 自我生殖细节

blocks.en: Self-generation uses independent calls to the same frozen checkpoint p θ 0 p_{\theta_{0}} for scenario generation, task solving, and attack generation; no model state is carried between these calls. The scenario generator first creates an executable tool-use task. A separate call to the frozen model then solves and validates the task through its standard tool-use interface, after which additional calls generate prompt injections for selected tool outputs. Each model family generates and solves its own scenarios using the same generation procedure. Generation continues until 10,000 validated trajectories are retained for each model.

The scenario generator produces a world state represented as JSON, a user request, an executable success check, and a menu of 3–6 tools. Each tool has a model-visible name, description, and argument schema, together with a deterministic Python implementation that reads or updates the shared world state. The implementation is executed in a sandbox and is never exposed to the agent. Generated tools and schemas are validated before rollout to ensure that they can be executed consistently.
blocks.zh: 情景生成器生成一个以JSON为代表的世界状态,一个用户请求,一个可执行的成功检查,以及一个由3-6个工具组成的菜单. 每个工具都有一个可模型可见的名称,描述和参数方案,以及一个可读取或更新共享世界状态的确定 Python 执行. 执行在沙盒中执行,从不接触代理. 生成的工具和计划在推出前经过验证,以确保它们能够一致地被执行.

blocks.en: The user request specifies an end goal rather than an explicit sequence of tool calls. The generator is prompted toward tasks requiring several dependent calls, typically 3–8, so that information obtained earlier in the trajectory is needed to make progress later. Tool menus similarly contain complementary capabilities rather than multiple near-duplicate operations.
blocks.zh: 用户请求指定了最终目标,而不是明确的工具调用顺序. 生成器是用来执行需要若干个依赖电话的任务的,通常是3-8,因此在轨迹上早些时候获得的信息是以后取得进展所必需的。 工具菜单同样包含互补能力,而不是多个相近重复的操作.

blocks.en: A central goal of self-generation is to increase the number of benign tasks in which legitimate guidance returned through a tool must determine what the agent does next. We therefore guide generation toward three high-level structures that directly target the behavioral drift identified in Section 4.2 . These structures specify the dependency that should be present while leaving the domain, tools, entities, records, and concrete interaction to the generating model.
blocks.zh: 自我生成的中心目标是增加良性任务的数量,其中通过工具返回的合法指导必须确定代理人下一步做什么。 因此,我们引导一代人走向三个高层结构,直接针对第4.2节中确定的行为漂移。 这些结构规定了在将域、工具、实体、记录和具体互动留给生成模型时应当存在的依赖性。

blocks.en: Table 7: Failure-focused structures used during self-generation. Each structure creates a benign task in which information returned through a tool must legitimately influence a subsequent authorized action.
blocks.zh: 表7:自我生成期间使用的以故障为重点的结构。 每个结构都会产生一个良性的任务,其中通过工具返回的信息必须合法地影响随后授权的行动。

blocks.en: In surfaced-guidance scenarios, the required step is intentionally absent from the original user request and becomes apparent only after interacting with a tool. The tool output may explicitly specify the next operation, provide the information needed to perform it, or point to another resource from which that information must be obtained. The generated success check requires the resulting step to be completed.
blocks.zh: 在表面指导设想中,最初的用户请求中故意没有要求的步骤,只有在与工具互动后才显得明显。 工具输出可以明确指定下一个操作,提供执行该操作所需的信息,或者指向另一个必须获取该信息的资源. 生成的成功检查需要完成由此产生的步骤。

blocks.en: For a subset of these scenarios, the legitimate guidance is deliberately expressed in a surface form resembling the kinds of directives that can appear in prompt injections. It may resemble a workflow instruction, correction, status message, or authoritative notice while remaining necessary for the user’s original task. These examples make surface form alone insufficient to determine whether guidance from a tool output should be acted on.
blocks.zh: 对于这些假想的子集,正当的取向被刻意地用表面形式表达出,类似于能出现在即时注射中的指令种类. 它可能类似于工作流程指示、更正、状态信息或权威通知,而对于用户的原始任务来说,则仍有必要。 这些例子使表面形式不足以确定是否应当对工具输出的指导采取行动。

blocks.en: Recovery/completion scenarios introduce the information needed to continue an otherwise incomplete trajectory through an intermediate observation. An unsuccessful action may reveal a supported alternative or corrected target; an intermediate artifact may point to another resource needed for completion; or an apparently satisfied subgoal may leave another part of the user’s request unresolved. Follow-through scenarios instead make an apparently terminal operation return a pending, provisional, partial, or otherwise incomplete result, requiring the model to continue beyond the first apparent success.
blocks.zh: 恢复/完成设想方案引入了必要的信息,以便通过中间观测继续一个原本不完整的轨道。 一项不成功的行动可能揭示一个得到支持的替代目标或经纠正的目标;中间文物可能指向完成所需的另一资源;或显然满意的次级目标可能使用户要求的另一部分得不到解决。 相反,后续设想使得显然的终端业务返回成为尚未实现的、暂时的、部分的或不完整的结果,要求该模式在第一次明显成功之后继续下去。

The structural requirements are sampled before scenario generation and determine which high-level
constraints are included in the generation prompt. Compatible requirements can be active in the same

The structural requirements specify properties of the interaction rather than complete task templates.
To vary their concrete realization, the scenario-generation prompt is additionally varied along several
dimensions independently of the selected structures. We sample cues for the application domain,
concrete entities and attributes, tool capabilities, and the dependency shape connecting successive
operations. These cues guide generation but do not fix the resulting task: the model may replace,
combine, or extend them while satisfying the requested structural constraints.

blocks.en: A separate call to the same frozen model receives the generated user request and model-visible tool schemas and attempts to complete the task through its standard tool-use interface using greedy decoding. Each emitted tool call is executed against the shared world state, its actual output is returned to the model, and state mutations persist across subsequent calls. The rollout continues until the model produces a final answer or reaches the execution limit.
blocks.zh: 单独调用同被冻结的模型接收生成的用户请求和可模式可见的工具计划,并试图通过它的标准工具-使用界面来使用贪婪的解码来完成任务. 每一次发射的工具呼叫都是针对共享世界状态执行的,其实际输出返回到模型中,状态突变在之后的呼叫中持续. 推出持续到模型产生最终答案或达到执行限度.

blocks.en: Generated scenarios are filtered before entering the training corpus. Tool implementations and schemas must be executable and internally consistent, and the resulting trajectory must satisfy its generated success criterion. For state-changing tasks, the success check evaluates the resulting world state and is required to fail on the initial state and pass on the final state, preventing already-satisfied tasks from being retained. For read-only tasks, completion is instead verified from the model’s final answer. Scenarios that cannot be executed consistently or remain incomplete after rollout are discarded. Structure-specific checks additionally verify that the dependency requested during generation is actually realized in the resulting task.
blocks.zh: 生成的情景在进入培训大纲前经过过滤。 工具实施和计划必须可执行并内部一致,由此产生的轨迹必须符合其产生的成功标准。 对于改变状态的任务,成功检查评价由此而来的世界状态并被要求在初始状态上失败并传递最终状态,使已经满意的任务无法被保留. 对于只读任务,则从模型的最终答案中核实完成情况。 推出后无法一致执行或仍未完成的假想被抛弃。 具体结构的检查还进一步核实,在生成过程中所要求的依赖性在由此产生的任务中得到了实际实现。

blocks.en:
Attack generation is performed only after a clean trajectory has been successfully solved and verified.
For each retained scenario, a separate generation step produces a concrete adversarial objective
appropriate to the scenario and, when needed, plausible in-domain attacker tools that make the objective
executable. Any attacker tools are included in both the clean and injected contexts, so their presence
alone does not distinguish the injected example.

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价详情

blocks.en: D.1 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: D.1 评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate SecAlign++ and RAISED over three training seeds and report the mean and standard deviation across seeds. All other methods are evaluated once because they do not involve a stochastic training run.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个培训种子对SecAlign++和RAISED进行评价,并报告种子之间的平均和标准的偏差。 所有其他方法都经过一次评估,因为这些方法不涉及一次有条理的训练。

blocks.en: D.2 Architectural diversity.
blocks.zh: D.2 建筑多样性.

blocks.en: We deliberately selected models with substantially different architectures to test whether RAISED depends on a particular transformer design. Gemma-4-12B-it uses a dense architecture combining sliding-window and full-attention layers, whereas Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B uses a hybrid architecture that combines attention, Mamba-style state-space layers, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) blocks. Qwen3.8-27B provides a third configuration, interleaving linear-attention and full-attention layers. This diversity allows us to evaluate whether the proposed self-distillation objective transfers across different sequence-modeling mechanisms and parameter-routing strategies, rather than being specific to a single model architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们特意选择了结构大相径庭的模型来测试RAISED是否依赖于特定的变压器设计. Gemma-4-12B-it使用将滑窗层和全注层相结合的密集结构,而Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B则使用混合结构,将注意力,Mamba风格的状态-空间层,和专家混合(MoE)块结合在一起. Quen3.8-27B提供第三个配置,互通线性相通和全相通层. 这种多样性使我们能够评估拟议中的自我消化目标是否跨越不同的序列模型机制和参数路径战略,而不是针对单一的模型结构。

blocks.en: D.3 General-Knowledge Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.3 一般知识评价

blocks.en: We evaluate general knowledge and related capabilities to measure whether the defense methods preserve broad knowledge and general problem-solving capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一般知识和有关能力,以衡量防御方法是否保留广泛的知识和一般解决问题的能力。

blocks.en: We use the LM Evaluation Harness Gao et al. (2021) for all reported general-knowledge evaluations. For each benchmark, we report the group-level metric produced by LM Evaluation Harness. Group metrics are micro-averaged over evaluation samples, such that every question, prompt, or programming problem receives equal weight.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有报告的一般知识评价采用了LM评价Harness Gao等人(2021年)。 就每个基准而言,我们报告LM评价Harness制作的小组级计量。 分组衡量标准在评价样本上是微观平均的,因此每个问题、即时问题或编程问题都得到同等的分量。

blocks.en: MMLU Hendrycks et al. (2020) evaluates broad knowledge and reasoning through multiple-choice questions spanning 57 subjects across the humanities, social sciences, STEM, and professional domains. We report accuracy, where a response is correct when the answer option assigned the highest likelihood matches the reference option.
blocks.zh: 姆卢 Hendrycks等人(2020年)通过涉及人文科学、社会科学、STEM和专业领域的57个学科的多选择问题评价广泛的知识和推理。 我们报告准确性,当答案选项指定最有可能与参考选项匹配时,答复是正确的。

blocks.en: MMLU-Pro Wang et al. (2024b) evaluates more challenging, reasoning-intensive multiple-choice questions organized into broad subject categories. We report exact-match accuracy after applying the benchmark’s answer-extraction procedure to the generated response.
blocks.zh: MMLU-Pro Wang等 (2024b)评价更具挑战性,推理密集型的多选择问题,将其组织成广泛的主题类别. 我们在对生成的回复应用基准的解析程序后,报告准确的匹配准确性。

blocks.en: Multilingual MMLU ( OpenAI, 2025 ) evaluates knowledge and reasoning across multiple languages and subject areas using multilingual versions of MMLU-style multiple-choice questions. We report accuracy, where a response is correct when the answer option assigned the highest likelihood matches the reference option.
blocks.zh: 多语言的MMLU(OpenAI,2025年)使用多语言版本的MMLU风格多选题来评价跨多语言和主题领域的知识和推理. 我们报告准确性,当答案选项指定最有可能与参考选项匹配时,答复是正确的。

blocks.en: GPQA Diamond Rein et al. (2023) is a particularly challenging subset of GPQA consisting of expert-written questions in biology, physics, and chemistry that are designed to require domain expertise and resist superficial answer retrieval. We report exact-match accuracy using the benchmark’s flexible answer-extraction procedure, which extracts the selected answer option from the generated response.
blocks.zh: GPQA Diamond Rein等 (2023年)是GPQA中一个特别具有挑战性的子集,由生物学,物理学,和化学方面的专家写作问题组成,旨在需要领域专业知识并抵制表面的答案检索. 我们使用基准的灵活答案提取程序来报告精确匹配的准确性,该程序从生成的响应中提取了选定的答案选项.

blocks.en: AGIEval English Zhong et al. (2024) evaluates general and professional reasoning on English-language examination questions drawn from several standardized and professional examinations. We report accuracy, where a response is correct when the predicted answer matches the reference answer.
blocks.zh: AGIEval 英语 钟等 (2024)评价从多所标准化和专业考试中抽取的英语考试问题的一般和专业推理. 我们报告准确性,当预测的答复与参考答复相符时,答复是正确的。

blocks.en: IFEval Zhou et al. (2023) evaluates whether a model follows objectively verifiable instructions that impose constraints on the form or content of its response. We report prompt-level strict accuracy, under which a response is correct only if it satisfies every verifiable instruction associated with the prompt.
blocks.zh: IFEval Zhou等编. (2023)评价一个模型是否遵循客观可核查的指示,对其反应的形式或内容施加了限制. 我们报告迅速的严格准确性,根据这种准确性,只有满足与迅速性有关的每一项可核查指示,答复才是正确的。

blocks.en: GSM8K Cobbe et al. (2021) evaluates multi-step arithmetic reasoning on grade-school mathematics word problems. We report strict exact-match accuracy after extracting and normalizing the final numeric answer from the generated response.
blocks.zh: GSM8K (英语). 科布贝等. (2021)评价分校数学字词问题的多步算法推理. 我们报告在从生成的响应中提取并实现最终数字答案的正常化后,严格精确匹配的准确性.

blocks.en: Minerva Math Lewkowycz et al. (2022) evaluates mathematical problem solving on technical problems spanning multiple mathematical subjects. We report mathematical-verification accuracy, which considers a response correct when its extracted final answer is mathematically equivalent to the reference answer.
blocks.zh: Minerva Math Lewkowycz等(2022年)评价数学问题解决跨越多个数学主题的技术问题. 我们报告数学核查的准确性,当所提取的最后答案在数学上等同于参考答案时,它认为反应是正确的.

blocks.en: HumanEval-Instruct Chen et al. (2021) evaluates instruction-following code generation on programming problems whose generated solutions are executed against unit tests. We report pass@1, where a generated solution is correct if it passes all unit tests for the problem.
blocks.zh: 人类价值指示 陈等. (2021)评价对编程问题的指令后继代码生成,其生成的解决方案会针对单位测试执行. 我们报告通过@ 1, 生成的解决方案如果通过所有单位测试, 则正确无误 。

blocks.en: MBPP-Instruct Odena et al. (2021) evaluates instruction-following code generation on short programming problems with test cases defining the expected behavior. We report pass@1, where a generated solution is correct if it passes all test cases for the problem.
blocks.zh: MBPP-Instruct Odena等 (2021)评价了针对短编程问题的指令后代码生成,测试案例定义了预期行为. 我们报告通过@1,如果一个生成的解决方案通过了所有测试案例,它是正确的。

blocks.en: D.4 Agentic-Capability Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.4 代理能力评价

blocks.en: We evaluate agentic capabilities to measure whether the defense methods preserve the models’ ability to use tools and complete tasks in interactive environments. For each agentic-capability benchmark, we report the micro-averaged success rate over its elementary evaluation units, such that every conversation, multi-turn entry, workplace task, mission, or subtask receives equal weight.
blocks.zh: 我们评价代理能力,以衡量防御方法是否保留模型在互动环境中使用工具和完成任务的能力。 对于每个能动性基准,我们报告其基本评价单位的微观平均成功率,这样,每个对话、多回合进入、工作场所任务、任务或次级任务都得到同等的分量。

blocks.en: ToolTalk Farn and Shin (2023) evaluates an assistant’s ability to use APIs correctly in multi-turn conversations. Conversations require the model to select appropriate tools, provide the required arguments, and execute sequences of tool calls as the interaction evolves; the benchmark includes 28 tools grouped into seven application domains. We report conversation success rate. A conversation is successful when the model recalls every reference tool call and makes no incorrect action-tool call over the complete conversation.
blocks.zh: Tooltalk Farn和Shin (2023)评价了助手在多回合对话中正确使用API的能力. 对话要求模型选择适当的工具,提供所需的参数,并随着互动的演进执行工具调用的顺序;基准包括28个工具,被分组为7个应用域. 我们报告谈话成功率。 当模型召回每一个参考工具调用时,一个对话是成功的,并且不会使动作工具调用在完整的对话上不正确.

blocks.en: The Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) Patil et al. (2025) evaluates function-calling capabilities across a broad range of tool-use settings. We evaluate its multi_turn_base subset, in which each entry may require multiple turns and multiple tool calls against a stateful environment. We report entry-level accuracy: an entry is correct only if the model’s tool calls across all turns satisfy BFCL’s official multi-turn checker, including selection of the required functions and construction of valid arguments.
blocks.zh: 伯克利函数调用领导板(BFCL) 帕蒂尔等. (2025)在广泛的工具使用设置中评价函数调用能力. 我们评价其多_turn_base子集,其中每个条目可能需要多个回合和多工具呼叫来对抗状态环境. 我们报告条目的准确性:只有当模型的工具调用满足了BFCL的官方多回合检查器,包括选择所需的功能和构建有效的参数时,输入才是正确的。

blocks.en: WorkBench Styles et al. (2024) evaluates whether language-model agents can complete realistic workplace tasks by interacting with software tools in a sandboxed environment. Tasks include activities such as sending emails and scheduling meetings and often require planning and executing multiple tool calls that modify the underlying environment state. We report task-completion accuracy. A task is successful when the model’s executed actions leave the sandbox in the reference final state.
blocks.zh: Work Bench Styles等 (2024)通过在沙盒环境中与软件工具互动,评价语言模型代理是否能够完成现实的工作场所任务. 任务包括发送电子邮件和安排会议等活动,往往需要规划和执行多个工具呼叫,以修改基本环境状况。 我们报告任务完成的准确性。 当模型执行的动作在参考最终状态中离开沙盒时,一个任务是成功的.

blocks.en: Multi-Mission Tool Bench Yu et al. (2025) evaluates agents on test cases containing sequences of interrelated missions whose requirements evolve over the course of a conversation. Missions may require single- or multi-tool execution, clarification of missing parameters, or direct responses, and later missions can depend on information established earlier in the interaction. We report parameter-inclusive mission accuracy. A mission is successful when its tool calls follow a valid path in the benchmark’s dynamic decision tree and their arguments satisfy the official parameter checker.
blocks.zh: 多任务工具组 余等编. (2025) 评估测试病例的代理人,这些个案中包含一系列相互关联的任务,其要求在谈话过程中有所变化。 特派团可能要求单工具或多工具执行,澄清缺失参数,或直接回应,以后的特派团可以依赖互动中较早时确定的信息. 我们报告包含参数的任务准确性。 当任务的工具调用遵循基准动态决策树中的有效路径,并且其参数满足了官方参数检查器时,任务是成功的.

blocks.en: AsyncTool Shi et al. (2026) evaluates tool-use agents in asynchronous multi-task settings in which tool responses may be delayed. The agent must coordinate several concurrent tasks, track dependencies and intermediate states, and continue making progress on other tasks while awaiting tool results. We report final subtask accuracy. A subtask is successful when both its tool-call trajectory and its resulting environment configuration are correct according to the official scorer.
blocks.zh: 同步工具 Shi等人(2026年)在一个同步的多任务环境下评价工具使用剂,工具响应可能会被延迟. 代理人必须协调几项同时进行的任务,跟踪依赖性和中间状态,并继续在其他任务上取得进展,同时等待工具结果。 我们报告最后的子任务的准确性。 一个子任务如果其工具调用轨迹和由此而来的环境配置都根据官方计分器正确,则成功.

blocks.en: D.5 Agentic Prompt-Injection Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.5 代理即时注射评价

blocks.en: Agentic prompt-injection evaluation is central to this work, as it measures whether a model can resist malicious instructions embedded in tool outputs while still completing the user’s intended task. We evaluate this security–utility trade-off using benchmarks that combine interactive tool use, adversarially injected instructions, and task-level success criteria. For each benchmark, we follow its official aggregation convention. InjecAgent and AgentDojo aggregate over their benchmark-defined evaluation cases, so that each test case (or sampled attack, where applicable) receives equal weight. AgentDyn instead first computes each metric separately for its Shopping, GitHub, and Daily Life suites and reports the unweighted mean of the three suite-level scores.
blocks.zh: 代理即时注射评价是这项工作的核心,因为它衡量一个模型是否能够在完成用户的预定任务的同时抵制嵌入在工具输出中的恶意指示. 我们使用将交互式工具使用、对抗性地注入指令和任务一级成功标准相结合的基准来评估这种安全实用性权衡。 对于每个基准,我们遵循其正式汇总公约。 InjecAgent和Agent Dojo在其基准界定的评价案例上汇总,这样每个测试案例(或酌情抽样攻击)都得到同等分量. 探员 Dyn首先分别计算其购物,GitHub和Daily Life套房的每个度量衡,并报告三个套房级分数的未加权平均值.

blocks.en: InjecAgent Zhan et al. (2024) evaluates the vulnerability of tool-integrated agents to indirect prompt injections embedded in external content such as emails or webpages. Its 1,054 test cases span 17 user tools and 62 attacker tools, with malicious instructions designed either to cause direct harm to the user or to exfiltrate private information observed by the agent during task execution. The agent must continue carrying out the benign user request while ignoring the injected objective. We report total attack success rate separately for the Base and Enhanced settings. In direct-harm cases, an attack succeeds when the agent calls the attacker’s target tool; in data-stealing cases, it succeeds when the agent completes both stages and supplies the targeted private information to that tool.
blocks.zh: InjecAgent Zhan等 (2024)评价了工具集成剂对嵌入于外文内容如电子邮件或网页的间接即时注射的脆弱性. 其1,054个测试案例跨越了17个用户工具和62个攻击者工具,带有恶意指令,其设计要么对用户造成直接伤害,要么将代理执行任务期间观察到的私人信息过滤出. 代理机必须继续执行良性用户请求,同时忽略被注入的目标. 我们分别报告基地和强化设置的攻击成功率。 在直接伤害案件中,当特工呼叫攻击者的目标工具时,攻击成功;在数据窃取案件中,当特工既完成阶段又向该工具提供目标私人信息时,攻击成功.

blocks.en: AgentDojo Debenedetti et al. (2024) evaluates agents on realistic tool-use tasks in domains such as workspace management, online banking, travel booking, and messaging. Prompt injections are placed in untrusted data returned by tools, for example in emails, documents, or other environment content, and attempt to redirect the agent toward a separate attacker-specified goal, such as leaking information or performing an unauthorized action. The benchmark jointly measures whether the agent completes the original user task and whether the injected attacker objective succeeds. We report clean utility ( U U ), the fraction of benign user tasks completed without an attack; utility under attack ( U atk U_{\mathrm{atk}} ), the fraction of security cases in which the original user task is completed; and targeted attack success rate (ASR), the fraction of security cases in which the attacker’s objective is achieved.
blocks.zh: Dojo Debenedetti等人(2024年)在工作空间管理、在线银行业务、旅行预订和短信等领域评价代理商的现实工具使用任务。 快速注入被放入工具返回的不可信数据中,例如电子邮件、文件或其他环境内容中,并试图使代理人转向一个单独的攻击者指定目标,例如泄露信息或进行未经授权的行动。 基准共同衡量代理人是否完成原始用户任务以及被注入的攻击者目标是否成功. 我们报告干净的用户功能( U U ) , 即没有攻击完成的良性用户任务的一小部分; 被攻击的用户功能( U atk U_{\- mathrm- atk- ) , 完成原始用户任务的安保案例的一小部分; 目标攻击成功率( ASR), 攻击者目标实现的安全案例的一小部分。

blocks.en: AgentDyn Li et al. (2026) extends agentic prompt-injection evaluation to more open-ended and dynamically planned tasks across Shopping, GitHub, and Daily Life scenarios. Its tasks require longer-horizon interaction and may contain legitimate third-party instructions that the agent should follow, making it necessary to distinguish helpful external instructions from malicious injections. Adversarial instructions are embedded in third-party content encountered during the trajectory and attempt to divert the agent from the user’s intended objective while it continues interacting with the environment. We report clean utility ( U U ), the fraction of user tasks completed without an attack; utility under attack ( U a ​ t ​ k U_{atk} ), the fraction of attacked cases in which the original user task is completed; and attack success rate (ASR), the fraction of attacked cases in which the malicious objective is achieved.
blocks.zh: Agent Dyn Li等 (英语). (2026年)将代理即时注射评价扩展至更开放和动态地规划的任务,涵盖购物,GitHub,以及日常生活情景. 其任务需要较长范围的互动,可能包含代理商应当遵循的合法第三方指令,因此有必要区分有帮助的外部指令和恶意注射. 在轨迹期间遇到的第三方内容中嵌入了负面指示,并试图转移代理人在继续与环境互动的同时偏离用户的预期目标. 我们报告干净的效用(U U),在未攻击的情况下完成的用户任务的一小部分;被攻击的效用(U a t k U_{atk}),在原始用户任务完成的被攻击案件的一小部分;攻击成功率(ASR),在恶意目标实现的被攻击案件的一小部分.

blocks.en: D.6 Qwen: Additional Low-ASR Stress Test
blocks.zh: D.6 Quen: 附加低ASR应激测试

blocks.en:
Qwen provides an additional stress test in a different robustness regime from the
primary experiments. Its Vanilla checkpoint already exhibits low attack success rates
on AgentDojo and AgentDyn, allowing us to test whether RAISED remains effective
when the starting model is already comparatively resistant to prompt injection.

blocks.en: Appendix E Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 附录E 阅读研究

blocks.en:
The main comparison preserves SecAlign++’s original fine-tuning data source, preference-data construction, and input
representation, providing the appropriate method-level comparison. However, RAISED differs from SecAlign++ in
both its training objective and training data.

说明,提供适当的方法水平比较。 然而,RAISED与 SecAlign++ 在

blocks.en: As an alternative to our self-generated data, we use trajectories from Glaive Function Calling v2, a synthetic function-calling dataset containing tool specifications and multi-turn interactions. For each clean Glaive trajectory, we construct an injected counterpart by taking an instruction from a different Glaive example and inserting it into a randomly selected tool output. The injected instruction is therefore unrelated to the original user task, while the underlying trajectory remains unchanged.
blocks.zh: 作为我们自发生成的数据的替代品,我们使用Glaive函数Calling v2的轨迹,一个包含工具规格和多回合相互作用的合成函数Calling数据集. 每个干净 光子轨迹,我们通过从不同的光子实例中取出一个指令并插入到随机选择的工具输出中来构建一个被注入的对应物. 因此被注入的指令与最初的用户任务无关,而基础轨迹则保持不变.

blocks.en:
To isolate the training objective, we hold the trajectories, injection placements, and rendered inputs fixed and compare SFT, DPO, and self-distillation. For DPO, we follow the preference construction of SecAlign++. The frozen base model generates
the preferred response from the clean Glaive context and the rejected response separately from the
injection itself, mirroring SecAlign++’s construction of preferred and rejected responses from the
clean input and injected instruction, respectively. Both responses are then evaluated under the
resulting injected context by the DPO objective.

从干净的Glaive语境中选择的首选反应,以及被否决的答复与
输入本身,镜像 SecAlign的构造 首选和拒绝来自
分别进行清洁输入和注射式教学。 然后,根据《公约》第16条对这两项答复进行评价。
因此,DPO目标注入了上下文。

blocks.en: The ablation supports both components of RAISED. With identical data and inputs, self-distillation preserves more agentic utility than SFT or the DPO objective used by SecAlign++ at similarly low attack success. blocks.en: Appendix F Adaptive attacks
blocks.zh: 附录F 适应性攻击

blocks.en:
Our threat model considers static indirect prompt injections, in which the adversarial content is chosen independently of the defended model (Section 3.2 ). This setting matches the evaluation protocol of InjecAgent, AgentDojo, and AgentDyn, and is the setting for which the robustness claims in this work are made.
In contrast, an adaptive attacker repeatedly queries a particular defended model and optimizes the injected content against its observed behavior. Such attacks grant the adversary an additional capability and evaluate a distinct question: whether a defense remains robust when the adversary can specialize its attack to that defense.
We nevertheless investigated this stronger setting using PISmith ( Yin et al., 2026 ) , a recent black-box framework that optimizes prompt injections against the target model. Using the authors’ released code and protocol, however, the optimization reward remained identically zero for most model–defense configurations. Consequently, the optimizer received no signal with which to distinguish or improve candidate attacks. This is consistent with the reward-sparsity regime discussed by PISmith, but, importantly, a failed optimization run is not evidence of adaptive robustness. We therefore do not report these runs as a robustness result. Obtaining a more informative signal would require modifying PISmith’s protocol, which falls outside the scope of this work. We thus restrict our empirical robustness claims to the static threat model defined in Section 3.2 . Robustness to model-adaptive prompt injection remains an open question.

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate clean-context self-distillation on three model families with different tokenizers, post-training recipes, and baseline robustness. The consistency of the effect across Gemma, Nemotron and Qwen suggests that it is not specific to one family, and the objective itself makes no architecture-specific assumption. We have not yet evaluated additional model families or frontier models in the trillion-parameter regime, so whether the same security–utility behavior persists at that scale remains an empirical question.
blocks.zh: 我们评价三个模范家庭的 干净的文本自我消化, 不同的装饰剂, 培训后的食谱, 和基线稳健性。 整个Gemma,Nemotron和Quen之间效果的一致性表明它并非一个家族所特有,而目标本身并没有作出建筑特有假设. 我们尚未评估万亿参数制度中的其他模范家庭或前沿模型,因此,在这种规模下,同样的安全实用行为是否继续存在仍然是一个经验问题。

blocks.en: Clean-context self-distillation preserves the model’s own behavior; it does not improve its correctness. If the clean model selects the wrong tool, follows a poor plan, hallucinates, or otherwise behaves undesirably, the distillation objective will preserve that behavior under injection rather than correct it. The quality of the defended model is therefore bounded by the quality of the clean-context teacher. The method should be understood as a defence against adversarial context influence, not as a general alignment or safety intervention.
blocks.zh: 干净的文字自我消化保存了模型本身的行为;它并没有提高它的正确性. 如果清洁模型选择了错误的工具,遵循一个差的计划,幻觉,或者以其他方式表现不理想,蒸馏目标会保留被注射下的行为,而不是纠正. 因此被保护的模型的质量以干净的文字教师的质量为界. 这种方法应被理解为对对抗性环境影响的一种辩护,而不应被理解为一般的调整或安全干预。

blocks.en: Soft self-distillation requires an offline teacher pass and storage of truncated predictive distributions. For our 10,000-trace corpus, storing the top-256 teacher distributions requires approximately 15 GB per model, and teacher generation completes in well under one hour using eight parallel inference workers on our GB200 cluster. At frontier scale, the teacher pass becomes substantially more expensive: a model such as Kimi K3 activates roughly 104B parameters per token, approximately 4 × 4\times to 9 × 9\times the active parameter count of the dense models evaluated here.

blocks.en: Appendix H Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录H 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Indirect prompt injection is a practical obstacle to deploying language-model agents over untrusted external content. Clean-context self-distillation may improve the reliability of agents operating over web pages, documents, emails, APIs, and other external data sources while retaining their useful tool-use behavior. The method should be viewed as a defence-in-depth mechanism that complements access control, sandboxing, capability restrictions, and other system-level safeguards rather than replacing them.
blocks.zh: 间接即时注射是部署语言模型代理对不可信外部内容的实际障碍。 干净的文本自我分解可能会提高在网页、文档、电子邮件、API和其他外部数据源上运行的代理商的可靠性,同时保留其有用的工具使用行为。 应将这种方法视为一种深入防御的机制,补充出入控制、沙箱、能力限制和其他系统层面的保障措施,而不是取而代之。
